name: elmcap2
archetype: Event carry (FOMC consensus, deadline NO) on millions of capital
headline: Rests maker bids on near-certain outcomes and holds to resolution. Its profit is real, but it earns 4.2% a month on $5.7M of capital at risk, below the 10% bar, and almost all of the last month's profit is one FOMC meeting.
mechanism: 98% of sampled fills are maker fills by count. About 107% of the 30-day settled PnL is the October 2026 FOMC book (+$257.9k on $4.39M bought at 0.92-0.97 within about 5 days of the statement); every other resolved market together lost $43.7k. The rest of the book is 'nothing happens by the deadline' NO positions bought at 0.99 or more. Idle cash is parked as complete sets in a market with no trades (JD Vance 2028: a $4M split on 2026-10-28) to earn holding yield; those sets carry no outcome risk and are no longer counted as capital at risk.

roc.detail: 4%/month: 30-day PnL $242,047 on peak capital at risk $5,708,768 (peak incl. parked complete sets $6,458,210); counting the on-chain collateral too ($648,638), at least 4%/month

onchain.detail: 200/200 sampled fills confirmed in Polygon OrderFilled events; 98% maker fills (95% CI 95%-99%), 93% of USDC

match.detail: not run by the project (rejected at A2). Reviewer rules fitted on 2025 and tested on 2026: FOMC consensus carry AUC 0.785 vs null 0.49 (p=0.0002) but recall 26%; deadline-NO carry AUC 0.854 (p=0.0003) but precision 5.6%: each describes part of the book

backtest.detail: reviewer FOMC-carry maker proxy on 2026 meetings: mean +13% per meeting over 4 filled meetings, t-test p=0.053, sign test p=0.0625; deadline-NO lost on FIT (-0.10% per market, one total loss) and earned +0.52% per market on TEST with zero losers, which says nothing about tail risk

replicable.detail: slow resting bids on public information, so technically replicable, but the carry is 0.3-6% per event: a replicator reusing the capital averages about 4% per month on peak capital, below 10%

persistence.detail: last 30 days not significant (p=0.18). [last 30 days p=0.18; decline vs earlier p=0.76; last 15 vs prior 15 p=0.78; trend p=1.00] The last month is one lumpy event (the October FOMC).

reasons: Return on capital 4.2% per month on $5,708,768 peak capital at risk; the bar is 10% per month.
The last 30 days are not significant on their own: the month's profit is essentially one FOMC meeting.
The public-data carry rules match parts of the book but are not significantly profitable held out.
corrections: Capital at risk no longer counts $4M of riskless complete sets parked for holding yield (peak $6.46M -> $5.71M; ROC 3.7% -> 4.2%).
Settled PnL in the profile is $217.4k after the SELL-accounting fix (was $214.2k).
Persistence was recorded 'not assessed'; the recent-window test fails (p=0.157).
The mechanism text attributed the month to long-dated political carry; it is the October FOMC book.
